idea-plugin.name: Dart Data Toolkit
idea-plugin.description:
Dart code generator for Flutter: copyWith, toJson, fromJson, toString, and barrel files — no boilerplate, straight from the editor.

Features:
  • copyWith() — creates a modified copy without changing the original
  • toJson() — serializes the class to a Map<String, dynamic>
  • fromJson() — deserializes a class from a JSON map
  • toString() — formatted multiline string representation
  • JSON → Dart class — paste a JSON object and generate a full Dart data class; nested objects become separate classes automatically
  • Barrel file — export selected Dart files from a folder into a single index file
Shortcuts:
  • Ctrl+Alt+D — generate methods for the class at the cursor
  • Ctrl+Alt+J — generate a Dart class from JSON
  • Ctrl+Alt+B — generate a barrel file for a folder
  • Alt+Insert — individual method actions in the Generate menu
Supports nullable types (String?, int?), generic types (List<T>, Map<K, V>), and nested JSON objects.

Getting Started:
  1. Open a Dart file and place the cursor inside a class
  2. Press Ctrl+Alt+D or right-click → Dart Data Methods...
  3. Select the methods to generate and click OK
Found a bug or have a suggestion? Open an issue on GitHub.
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.0.0
  • copyWith(), toJson(), fromJson(), toString() generators
  • JSON → Dart class: paste JSON and generate a complete Dart class with auto-formatting
  • Nested JSON objects generate separate, properly typed Dart classes
  • toJson() calls .toJson() on nested class properties
  • fromJson() calls ClassName.fromJson() on nested class properties
  • Barrel file generator with checkbox UI and recursive mode
  • Individual method actions in the Generate menu (Alt+Insert)
  • Nullable and generic type support
  • Fixed: copyWith parameter list now includes trailing comma
